usedFor: Shopify holds products, and TestMonitor holds test issues, so “New Product” can open one with “Create issue”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create issue” in TestMonitor
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets an issue with title, priority, assignee and tags, so someone checks the listing.

watchOut: “Update issue” works on an existing issue, so it needs one to exist before “New Product” can use it.
